question: Which regions had the highest received revenue in September 2026?

data.answer:
Receita recebida de 01/09/2026 a 30/09/2026, por região:
South: R$ 1.130.867,83.
Central-West: R$ 1.101.836,35.
Northeast: R$ 1.079.208,50.
North: R$ 1.042.099,97.
Southeast: R$ 825.090,13.

narrative.answer: The South region had the highest received revenue in September 2026, totaling R$ 1,130,867.83. It was followed closely by Central-West and Northeast, both staying above the R$ 1 million mark. Southeast was the only region to fall significantly behind, finishing with R$ 825,090.13.
highlights: South led the ranking with R$ 1,130,867.83
Southeast had the lowest revenue, R$ 825,090.13
caveats: The values represent gross received revenue and do not account for chargebacks.

operational_plan: Usar a definição versionada de received_revenue.
Filtrar por completed_at no período, com fim exclusivo.
Validar e executar uma consulta somente de leitura.
Apresentar valores retornados, SQL e limitações.

query.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT "r"."name" AS "region", SUM("p"."amount") AS "received_revenue" FROM "analytics"."payments" AS "p" JOIN "analytics"."orders" AS "o" ON "p"."order_id" = "o"."id" JOIN "analytics"."customers" AS "c" ON "o"."customer_id" = "c"."id" JOIN "analytics"."regions" AS "r" ON "c"."region_id" = "r"."id" WHERE "p"."status" = 'completed' AND "p"."completed_at" >= $2 AND "p"."completed_at" < $1 GROUP BY "r"."name" ORDER BY "received_revenue" DESC, "region" ASC) AS "_datapilot_result" LIMIT 10001

limitations: Base local sintética; não representa uma empresa real.
Não representa receita líquida; estornos não são modelados nesta seed.
Não juntar pagamentos a itens diretamente para somar valores; isso duplica pagamentos.
